c3ee0ae2be82b895a71e8a6bf6e297d95e5c4b1d: Abondance is a medieval village in the valley of the same name, known for its listed abbey (XIIe siècle) and its AOP dairy cattle breed. Its l'Essert ski area, reached by gondola, offers around ten runs between 930 and 1730 m served by 9 lifts, in an authentic, preserved setting linked to Les Portes du Soleil.
